assets.prompt: Create one production sprite atlas for the first-grade Chinese lesson 《小小的船》's delivery game. Transparent RGBA, strictly three columns × two rows of equal square cells, 3:2 landscape overall. Each cell contains one independent sprite, optically centered, all four edges and the entire invisible gutters fully transparent with at least 13% alpha-zero margin. Exactly this row-major order. Row 1 left: empty warm-orange toy postal van facing right, simple high three-quarter top view, visible low cargo bed, dark wheels, matte pine-green trim. Row 1 middle: precisely the same orange postal van at the same scale, angle and anchor, with its small cargo gate raised and no item in the bed. Row 1 right: simple longer cream-apricot toy traffic car facing right, high top view with dark wheels and dusky teal windshield, visually distinct from the postal van. Row 2 left: only a light apricot rabbit face with two long ears and small friendly nose, ears fully in view. Row 2 middle: only a full side view green turtle pointing right, clear rounded shell, head, four stubby legs, no plaque. Row 2 right: only a warm apricot cat face with two triangular ears and visible whiskers, no collar or neck. Matte gouache, fine paper grain limited to the opaque objects, clean cut-paper edges, original child-friendly art in warm cream, pine green, apricot and persimmon orange. All six silhouettes readable at 30 pixels, postal van recognizable at 22 pixels. No scene, no ground, no shadow, no glow, no colored aura, no translucent blur outside the silhouettes, no lettering, numbers, grid, checkerboard, badges, logos, watermark, or extra objects.
